scope: Atelier 1.9 revised Chicago demo integration: random startup, Chicago selection retention, previous/next route navigation, connecting flights and control bindings.
limitations: This record is not a compile, playback-test, GPU-test or native-interaction result.
Full playback and camera-clearance validation awaits the frozen Robie House/Hyde Park geometry.
The card-scrolling correction is assessed from the requested scroll targets in source; final native layout and visibility require the root agent’s app review.

checks.case: Select a Chicago view while paused or shuttling
checks.reason: View cards and valid number keys call selectStop; playback.select retains demoActive, resets route clocks and shuttle, and enters playing. Controller adopts the exact selected pose and synchronizes the controls without toggle or manual().

checks.case: Select a Chicago destination, including the current destination
checks.reason: Same-destination and resident-world branches both use playback.selectLocation. Active Chicago choices begin that location’s first route, retaining the demo, lighting and both pace preferences. No city rebuild occurs for ready Chicago-to-Chicago navigation.

checks.case: Random demo startup from Paris through asynchronous world loading
checks.reason: The controller saves lighting before loadLocation resets Paris playback, pauses drawing, loads the shared Chicago world, restores lighting, and chooses a random Chicago location/view. It immediately adopts playback.location. The loader completion does not overwrite that selection; it applies the current playback pose, resets previousTime and resumes drawing. Generation guards reject superseded loads.

checks.case: Location hotkey excludes Paris during demo
checks.reason: L and the native Next Location menu call toggleLocation, which chooses the Chicago-only list while demoActive. Explicit Paris selection uses the independent-world loader and playback.selectLocation exits demo, matching the documented exclusion.

checks.case: Next and previous adopt locations and lighting across route boundaries
checks.reason: Both displayed previous/next controls and Up/Down hotkeys use cycleView. During demo it navigates the flattened Chicago list and directly adopts playback.location and lighting, then refreshes pose, title, clocks and controls. It never re-selects the new location and therefore does not erase the selected last view when moving backward.

checks.case: Numbered view cards target the current destination
checks.reason: Cards derive from engine.stops; number key mapping and selectStop both check the current count. Chicago exposes eight choices and Paris nine. Active selection begins the chosen walkthrough rather than stopping demo.

checks.case: Connecting flights retain and resume demo without pausing it
checks.reason: The shared helper selects destination and flight, restores lighting, then only invokes toggleTour if the resulting state is not already playing. Chicago demo selection already enters playing, including from pause; it therefore avoids the old extra toggle that would pause the flight.

checks.case: Automatic route completion retains the resident world
checks.reason: draw advances the existing playback clock and adopts route/location changes without invoking loadLocation or selectLocation. The shader, city geometry and collision resources remain resident across automatic Chicago destination changes.

checks.case: Day/night wrap and pause contracts remain distinct from route navigation
checks.reason: Sequential next/previous changes lighting only at the complete city boundary; direct Chicago selection preserves it. Space delegates to playback.toggle and retains demoActive, while route-local left/right shuttles keep their existing boundary behavior.

checks.case: Selected card remains targeted when destination changes
checks.reason: After the review correction, both currentStop and location observers scroll to the selected currentStop, so random starts and previous-location final-view selections no longer request scrolling back to card 0.

resolvedFindings.summary: The location observer requested scrolling to view 0 even when random demo startup or previous-location navigation selected a later view.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The root agent changed the location observer to scroll to engine.currentStop with a centered anchor.
